Evidence:
[1] Rakhine United FC (Burmese: ရခိုင်ယူနိုက်တက် ဘောလုံးအသင်း ) Football Club is a professional football club, based in Rakhine State, that plays in the Myanmar National League.
[2] The club was refounded as AC Lugano in 2004 as a result of relegation and the financial situation of FC Lugano, which was founded in 1908.
[3] Their home stadium is the MBPJ Stadium, Kelana Jaya, Petaling Jaya, Selangor.
[4] Yao Guy-Eloge-Koffi (born 20 January 1996) is an Ivorian footballer who plays as a defender for FC Lugano.
